title: Atlas Robotics Form 8-K annual meeting results
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 5.07 Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.
Atlas Robotics held its annual meeting on May 8, 2026. Stockholders approved the election of all directors, approved the advisory vote on executive compensation, and rejected a shareholder proposal regarding a classified board. The final vote included 42,100,000 votes for and 3,500,000 votes against the compensation proposal.
